GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 5 Lengths Two Wide , shifted 3 Wide at 700m, clipped heels and lost rider at 550m. [Stewards: Clipped heels and fell dislodging rider at 500m. Post-race vet exam revealed no abnormalities.] # Lost rider
Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 4.5 Lengths on fence, Drifted Back to 5.5 Lengths Two Wide turning, Held Ground in Straight # never a real threat

Jumped awkwardly & Settled Down 4.5 Lengths 3 Wide , Moved Up to 2.5 Lengths 3 Wide turning, Held Up home turn then held ground with the winner imporoving from 6th to 3rd in straight. [Stewards: Post-race vet exam revealed a laceration to the off foreleg. Vet clearance required.] # injured in running
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly, shifted in and bumped a runner. Held up for clear running rounding the home turn until near the 300m. A post-race veterinary examination revealed a laceration to the off foreleg. Trainer was advised that a veterinary certificate would be required prior to the mare trialling or racing again.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly missing start & Settled Down 4.5 Lengths 3 Wide , Drifted Back to 7 Lengths 3 Wide turning, Dropped Out in straight. [Stewards: Rider reported it never travelled comfortably whilst racing Wide and felt it may have come to the end of its preparation. Trainer advised it would be spelled.] # always Wide
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly, bumped and lost ground. Raced wide throughout. Rdr reported mount never travelled comfortably whilst racing in a wide position and felt mare may have come to the end of preparation. Trnr advised going for a spell.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Away fairly. Not pushed early & raced behind Mid Field Two Wide (4L from lead). Stayed same until pushed along Five Wide @ 450m. Chasing Six Wide (5L from lead) on home turn. Gave ground Four Wide in straight. Vetted - lame near fore. # Pulled up lame.

Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 7 Lengths Two Wide , made no ground to Turn then shifted out to 7 Lengths 3 Wide , taken Four Wide rounding turn, 4-5 Wide Straightening Up and Made Ground down the outside in Straight # ran on fairly
Jumped just ok soon recovered along the Inside settled down Two Wide second 1-2 Lengths (800m), cornered for home 2 Lengths away all out, battled away Without threat # did have chance

Slow Out 1 1/2 Lengths Ridden Along Settled Down 5th 1x1 with cover 2 1/2 Lengths off leader/winner held together same to straightening up clear run home to 50m then was checked off heels by M Rodd - # allow 1L/slow time
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Awkward to begin. Near the 750m, when racing keenly, obliged to steady from heels.  Near the 50m, obliged to check from heels & lose rightful running.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly, Eased when tightened and Settled Down 6 Lengths Two Wide , Made Some Ground to 5 Lengths Two Wide turning, Made Some Ground along fence in straight. (Bit Lifter FIRST TIME, Concussion Plates (Front) OFF FIRST TIME, Norton Bit OFF FIRST TIME, Tongue Tie AGAIN) # never a factor
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Eased when tightened between runners shortly after the start. Near the 400m was steadied after improving onto heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Went Forward raced keenly in the lead 2 Lengths headed by winner on the turn battled on okay , Blinkers 1st Time , visors off # led/keen/faded turn
